description: CIS Benchmark rules for network device security hardening

rules.name: Ensure enable secret is set and encrypted
Ensure password encryption service is enabled

remediation.generic: Enable the password encryption service to encrypt all stored passwords.

remediation.cisco_ios:
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local
remediation.generic: Enable AAA authentication for all management access.

rules.name: Ensure minimum password length is at least 8 characters

remediation.generic: Set minimum password length to at least 8 characters.

rules.name: Ensure login attempt limit is configured

remediation.generic: Configure login attempt limits to prevent brute-force attacks.

remediation.juniper: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
remediation.paloalto: SSH v2 is the only version supported in PAN-OS.
remediation.generic: Configure SSH to use version 2 only.
Configure SSH session timeout to prevent idle sessions.

remediation.paloalto: set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet yes
remediation.generic: Disable Telnet and use SSH for all remote management.

rules.name: Ensure VTY access control lists are applied

remediation.juniper: set firewall family inet filter MGMT-FILTER ...
remediation.generic: Apply access control lists to restrict management access.

rules.name: Ensure logging is enabled with a remote destination

remediation.juniper: set system syslog host <ip> any notice
remediation.generic: Configure remote syslog logging to a centralized server.

remediation.juniper: set system syslog time-format year millisecond
remediation.generic: Enable timestamps on log messages for forensic analysis.

rules.name: Ensure CDP/LLDP is disabled on external interfaces

remediation.generic: Disable CDP/LLDP to prevent information disclosure on untrusted interfaces.

remediation.cisco_ios:
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
remediation.generic: Disable the HTTP management server; use SSH/HTTPS only.
Disable IP source routing to prevent routing attacks.

remediation.cisco_ios:
ntp authenticate
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 <key>
ntp trusted-key 1
remediation.juniper: set system ntp authentication-key 1 type md5 value <key>
remediation.paloalto: set network ntp-servers primary-ntp-server authentication-type symmetric-key
remediation.generic: Enable NTP authentication to prevent time-based attacks.

rules.name: Ensure SNMP community strings are not default

remediation.cisco_ios:
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
snmp-server community <custom-string> RO <acl>
remediation.generic: Replace default SNMP community strings (public/private) with strong, unique strings.

remediation.cisco_ios:
banner login ^C
Unauthorized access is prohibited.
^C
remediation.juniper: set system login message "Unauthorized access prohibited."
remediation.paloalto: set deviceconfig system login-banner "Unauthorized access prohibited."
remediation.generic: Configure a login banner warning against unauthorized access.
